Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Wasim Sadiq Nargal, Judge
 Order

The instant contempt petition has been preferred against the Order dated 20 th May, 2016,
whereby a direction has been issued to the then Deputy Commissioner, Pulwama, to look into the report of the Naib Tehsildar, Pampore, as has been submitted to him by the Tehsildar Pampore and based on the said report, award of compensation was required to be considered in accordance with the Land Acquisition Act.

It was further provided that the decision whatever permissible under law shall be taken by the Deputy Commissioner, within a period of four weeks from the date a copy of the said order was to be served upon the Deputy Commissioner.
02. This instant contempt petition is pending before this Court by way of second round of litigation.

03. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the earlier contempt petition has been preferred in the year 2018, in which, liberty was given to revive the contempt, in case the order is not complied with.

Learned counsel further submits that since the order passed in the earlier contempt petition was not complied with, the petitioner has chosen to file the instant contempt petition, in which, this Court, vide Order dated 1st February, 2023, directed the respondents to pass a fresh consideration order strictly in conformity with the Judgment passed by this Court mentioned supra within a period of four weeks' positively in the light of the fact that the earlier consideration order was not in conformity with the Judgment dated 20 th May,2016 passed by this Court in OWP No. 857/2016.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Admittedly, the respondents have not complied with the Judgment dated 20 th May, 2016,
despite there being a clear direction.

The conduct of the respondents is, prima facie, contemptuous and this is a fit case where the rule is required to be framed against the Deputy Commissioner,
Pulwama.

However, before proceeding further in the matter, last and final opportunity of four weeks is granted to the Deputy Commissioner, Pulwama, to comply with the Judgment dated 20th May,
2016, in its letter and spirit.
It is made clear that in case the Judgment as directed above is not complied with, the Deputy Commissioner, Pulwama, shall appear in person before this Court on the next date of hearing.

05. Registry to convey this order to the aforesaid Authority forthwith for its immediate compliance.
(WASIM SADIQ NARGAL) JUDGE SRINAGAR 08.07.2024
